authorization: Lead S3 directive at b22e959: expose the element CustomEvent contract through typed Angular @Output()s. No second state machine, single-listener authority, lifecycle correctness, preserved semantics, no controlled-value feedback loop, packaging intact. No CVA/S4, forms, SSR hydration/S5, core refactor, API-065/API-075, peer expansion.

error.reason: @Input() error (string) already owns the `error` identifier; a member cannot be both a string input and an EventEmitter. @Output('error') binds the wire name; payload ErrorEventDetail unchanged.

designGuarantees.payloadIdentity: The output value IS CustomEvent.detail (same object reference); asserted in tests.
designGuarantees.singleListenerAuthority: Exactly one listener per event registered on this component's own <enhanced-select>; idempotent; asserted one addEventListener('change') per mount.
designGuarantees.doubleDeliveryFix: Events bubble (bubbles+composed) and collide with native DOM event names, so Angular binds template (change) to both @Output and a native bubbling listener -> double delivery (raw CustomEvent + detail). Fixed by event.stopPropagation() at element boundary; regression test + negative control.
designGuarantees.installBeforeInit: attachEventListeners() runs in ngAfterViewInit before initialize(); events emitted during init are captured (asserted).
designGuarantees.cleanupOnDestroy: detachEventListeners() removes all captured listeners; no delivery after teardown (asserted).
designGuarantees.noFeedbackLoop: Programmatic change forwarded as-is; never written back to the value input (asserted cmp.value unchanged).
designGuarantees.ordering: select then change forwarded in dispatch order (asserted).
designGuarantees.ssrSafety: events.ts references core type-only; module import-safe on server (new SSR test).

R4_ngPackagrBuild.detail: exit 0; FESM has no static @smilodon/core import

negativeControl.method: Removed event.stopPropagation() from the bridge handler and ran the double-delivery test.
negativeControl.result: 1 failed (the guard test); source restored byte-identical; 36/36 pass with the fix.

disclosedLimitations: pageLoaded output exposed but enhanced-select does not currently _emit('pageLoaded'); contract completeness only.
error output uses documented coreError property / error binding alias.

relationshipToPriorIncrements.effect: Completes the Angular event bridge; S4 (CVA) and S5 (SSR hydration) remain NO-GO pending authorization.
